sentences.en: The entomologist could not find a specimen of the bug.
sentences.zh: 昆虫学家找不到那种虫子的样本。

sentences.en: My private library consists of more than a thousand specimens.
sentences.zh: 我的私人图书馆里有超过一千个样本。

sentences.en: A good specimen might weigh up to a kilo.
sentences.zh: 一个好的样本可能重达一公斤。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：speci（种类）+men（表名词） →种类的典型→样品
